title: The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons (Wenxin Diaolong)

publication.edition: English translation by Vincent Yu-chung Shih

verification.verification_notes: Translation verified via Open Library (Liu Hsieh; Shih; 1959); argument confirmed: literature is affection mediated by language, with pattern and sound intrinsic to literary form.

limitations: Classical Chinese prosody and tonal pattern cannot be reproduced in English; the transferable content is the principle that sound is intrinsic to form.

copyright.notes: Translated critical edition; analytical citation only; no text reproduced.
